source: Original procedural task-space choreography; not mocap.
coordinateSystem: +Y up, +Z forward, character left +X; 1m reference hip height
limitations: No target-Claude/eidoverse engine render test here.
Reference contact checks are ankle anchors, not sole or collision simulation.
No finger, face, lipsync or costume tracks.
This is an additional move library, not a word-aligned or retimed song.

moves.description: Big robot poses halt mid-groove twice, then catch up. Whole-body holds, not just still arms.

groups.label: Buffering Boyband
groups.description: A confident opening, one frozen centre performer, contagious lag and a shared star-jump recovery.

groups.label: CPU Overheat Emergency
groups.description: Toy-soldier precision degrades into face-fanning, mirror-image panic and a reverse reboot cascade.

groups.label: The Robot Chicken Council
groups.description: Synchronized flapping, alternating wings, a centre supervillain interrupted by chicken backing dancers, then a victory.

groups.label: Crab Rave Committee
groups.description: Wide side taps and claw silhouettes, a travelling timing ripple, noodle contrast and a synchronized star finish. Formation roots stay fixed.

groups.label: Domino Error Cascade
groups.description: Whole-body gasp and droop canons cross the group; progress-bar squats reverse the ripple before a joint celebration.

groups.label: Dance Battle 404
groups.description: A 64-beat left-versus-right battle, with a DJ referee, judging reactions, a chicken solo and a shared jumping finish.

groups.label: Popcorn Kernel Panic
groups.description: Small authored airborne hops move across the group, surround a startled centre and resolve in a simultaneous star jump.

groups.label: Office Party Executable
groups.description: Stiff office-march precision gives way to an imaginary DJ, synchronized air guitar and contagious disco glitches.

groups.label: Interrupted Villain Monologue
groups.description: A centre plotting-and-laughing solo, mischievous backing dancers, a gasp ripple and an embarrassing frozen monologue.

groups.label: Wrong-Way Rehearsal
groups.description: Opposing diagonal turns, alternating disagreement, a correction ripple and a ludicrously confident final pose.

groups.label: Noodle Factory Shift
groups.description: Fluid arm ripples build into windmills, alternate with controlled drooping bodies, and inexplicably turn into chicken choreography.

groups.label: Maximum Chaos Encore
groups.description: A 64-beat comic dance break with hero poses, high knees, overheating, chicken, popping, a total freeze and a star-jump finale.
